Description

SAIC is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Cloud Engineer to join our team in Alexandria, Virginia.

This role is deeply hands-on and combines Azure cloud architecture expertise with cybersecurity to support IL4, IL5, and IL6 environments. The successful candidate will have proven abilities to configure, troubleshoot, and support cloud systems while designing a future roadmap for modernization. The candidate will also lead and mentor team members to deliver secure, scalable, and efficient solutions that meet DoD and government standards.

Responsibilities:

• Provide technical leadership, setting direction for cloud and cybersecurity modernization efforts and creating a long-term cloud transformation roadmap.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to assess current cloud and cybersecurity posture, identify gaps, and define modernization objectives.

• Mentor and train team members to build subject matter expertise in cloud technologies, automation, and cybersecurity best practices.

• Drive innovation and align architectures with mission goals, ensuring operational excellence and future scalability.

• Demonstrate strong hands-on abilities to configure, deploy, manage, and troubleshoot Azure components, including VNets, subnets, NSGs, VPN gateways, and firewalls.

• Provide advanced troubleshooting for complex issues across infrastructure, networking, security, and applications in cloud environments.

• Implement and manage cloud network configurations to ensure secure traffic flow and connectivity, adhering to DoD and compliance standards.

• Enable secure hybrid and multi-cloud operation by integrating on-premises systems with Azure services.

• Lead efforts to secure systems operating in IL4, IL5, and IL6 environments, obtaining and maintaining Authority to Operate (ATO) certifications.

• Develop and maintain System Security Plans (SSPs) and ensure compliance with NIST 800-53, FISMA, and other DoD security frameworks.

• Execute vulnerability scans, analysis, remediation, and reporting using tools like ACAS, SonarQube, and Burp Suite.

• Implement secure workflows, including STIG hardening, SAST (Static Application Security Testing), and DAST (Dynamic Application Security Testing).

• Leverage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, ARM templates, and Bicep to deploy scalable, repeatable, and secure cloud solutions.

• Design and manage CI/CD pipelines with integrated security checks using tools like Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins to enable secure and seamless deployments.

• Automate monitoring, provisioning, and scaling of cloud infrastructure to ensure reliability and operational efficiency.

• Utilize automation to streamline security operations, including vulnerability management, compliance verification, and incident response.

• Deploy and manage Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters and containerized services using tools like Docker, ensuring security and scalability of modern applications.

• Oversee service mesh implementations (e.g., Istio) within Kubernetes environments to enhance security, monitoring, and observability.

• Enforce secure container image deployment practices and maintain container registries.

• Implement and manage monitoring solutions using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights for real-time observability.

• Respond to and resolve critical infrastructure or security incidents, implementing response workflows and automating mitigations where possible.

• Present key metrics on system performance, resource utilization, and overall cloud security posture to stakeholders in actionable formats.

• Conduct continuous performance tuning and resource optimization to balance performance demands with cost-effectiveness.

• Assist in forecasting future infrastructure needs and adjusting roadmap strategies for scalable growth.

• Use analytical and predictive tools to propose enhancements to the cloud environment that align with mission requirements.

Qualifications

Required Education:
• Bachelors and fourteen (14) years ore more experience; Masters and twelve (12) or more years experience; PhD or JD and nine (9) years or more experience; four (4) years of experience considered in lieu of degree.
Required Qualifications:
• Extensive hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure Cloud architecture, with the ability to implement, configure, and troubleshoot complex infrastructures.
• Proven track record of leading modernization efforts, including creating future-oriented strategies to align with cutting-edge cloud and cybersecurity technologies.
• Strong scripting and automation experience using tools such as Python, PowerShell, or similar.
• Proficiency in DevSecOps workflows, including CI/CD pipeline development with built-in security integration.
• Advanced experience with Kubernetes, containerization (e.g., Docker), and container security practices.
• Significant experience securing IL4, IL5, and IL6 environments, managing SSPs, POA&Ms, and ATO processes.
• Expertise in vulnerability lifecycle management, including scanning, analyzing, and remediating findings.
• Proficiency with compliance frameworks such as FISMA and NIST 800-53, and implementing controls to meet DoD standards.
• Exceptional problem-solving abilities with hands-on troubleshooting in cloud, networking, and cybersecurity domains.
• Excellent communication and leadership skills for mentoring teams and engaging with stakeholders on highly technical topics.
• Must be available to work on-site in Alexandria, VA, 5 days a week.
Preferred Qualifications:
• Advanced certifications in Azure (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert).
• Cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CEH, or CAP.
• Experience supporting DoD or other government-regulated cloud environments.
Clearance:
• Candidate must have an active Secret clearance.

Description

As Sr. Cloud Engineer III, you will be a key player in architecting, designing, and implementing cloud solutions that empower our clients to leverage the full potential of cloud technologies. You will be responsible for the development of a robust and scalable cloud infrastructure, serve as a technical mentor who guides, supports and accelerates the professional growth of junior engineers, all while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery to the missions.

What you’ll do:

Support the design and implementation of cloud-based architecture, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security in alignment with industry best practices.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements, troubleshoot issues, and optimize cloud infrastructure.
Mentor and provide technical guidance to a team of cloud engineers, reviewing their work, and helping them solve complex technical challenges.
Engage with stakeholders to translate technical requirements into actionable solutions, troubleshoot and resolve issues, and stay current on evolving cloud technologies and compliance standards.
Provide requirement decomposition/definition and engineering expertise to assure program requirements are developed and sustained.
Prepare operating instructions and end user training.
Develop and implement cloud governance strategies, ensuring compliance with relevant standards and regulations.
Lead efforts to automate deployment, monitoring, and management processes, enhancing efficiency and reducing manual intervention.
Act as a subject matter expert on cloud engineering best practices, participating in knowledge sharing and contributing to the company's technical community.
Participate in all phases of risk management assessments and architecture.
What you’ll need to succeed:

Minimum 10 years of experience as a Cloud Solution Architect or similar role, with a strong emphasis on cloud-based solution design and architecture.
Extensive experience building and leading AWS cloud infrastructure solutions at scale across multiple classification domains (IL5 to IL6+) simultaneously.
Extensive hands-on experience with leading cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including services such as EC2, S3, Lambda, EBS, etc.
Expert-level skills in creating, managing, and hardening desktop OS images across multiple classification domains in the cloud using AMIs.
In-depth understanding of cloud architecture patterns, microservices, serverless computing, containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and related technologies.
Expertise integrating with enterprise authentication and authorization systems.
Strong background in infrastructure-as-code (IAC) using tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible.
Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities, with a track record of developing innovative solutions to challenging technical problems.
In-depth understanding of cloud security best practices and experience implementing security controls in a cloud environment.
Excellent scripting and programming skills (Python, Bash, etc.).
Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Active TS//SCI with CI poly
Current certifications to meet 8140/8570 standards (e.g. Security+ or above)

Description

SAIC is a trusted leader in delivering advanced command and control capabilities across the Department of the Air Force, bringing deep expertise in how cutting edge technologies are engineered, secured, and delivered to the fight. At the center of this mission, the Common Mission Control Center (CMCC) unifies data, sensors, mission applications, cloud based services, and emerging AI enabled automation to give warfighters a decisive edge—turning complex, multidomain information into fast, clear, and actionable decisions in the moments that matter most. The CMCC System Facilitator contract positions SAIC to accelerate how new capabilities are integrated, tested, secured, and transitioned into operational use, working side by side with operators, engineers, Capability Providers, and government teams to ensure every delivery strengthens mission readiness. This effort offers the chance to directly shape how the Air Force sees, decides, and acts across all domains—making a tangible and immediate impact on warfighter effectiveness.

SAIC is seeking a highly qualified Senior Cloud Engineer (SME) to support the United States Air Force’s Common Mission Control Center Facilitator contract. This role provides expert-level cloud engineering leadership, supporting hybrid and multiclassification cloud environments, enabling secure data and network flows, and advancing the CMCC’s cloud, automation, and cross domain ecosystem. The Senior Cloud Engineer acts as a trusted technical advisor, supporting DSOP, integration, and cyber teams while mentoring engineers and strengthening CMCC’s resilient, secure deployment architecture.

Job Duties include:
• Architect, deploy, and maintain secure hybrid cloud environments (GovCloud, SC2S, on prem K8s) supporting CMCC development, test, experimental, and operational tiers.
• Design and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Configuration as Code (CaC) using Terraform, Ansible, Helm, and Argo CD.
• Develop automation pipelines and tooling to support CI/CD integration, cloud resource provisioning, and container orchestration.
• Enable secure data flows, cross domain integrations, and network configurations compliant with MLS/MILS and NSA “Raise the Bar” standards.
• Build and maintain cloud test environments—including hardware, software, and network components—and oversee cloud monitoring, observability, and incident response.
• Collaborate with DSOP, Cyber, Software, and Integration teams to ensure secure pipeline execution, STIG compliance, vulnerability scanning, and cATO aligned security automation.
• Mentor engineering team members and serve as a cloud technical authority during design reviews, risk assessments, and CCB/PI Planning activities.
• Identify opportunities for increased automation, performance optimization, cost-efficiency, and operational resiliency across CMCC cloud infrastructure.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications & Experience:
• Bachelors and eighteen (18) years or more of related experience; Masters and sixteen(16) years or more of related experience; PhD or JD and thirteen (13) years or more of related experience.
• TS/SCI Clearance or SCI Eligible.
• Extensive experience designing, operating, and securing hybrid or multiclassification cloud environments.
• Expertise with cloud platforms (AWS GovCloud, SC2S, Platform One) and containerization (Docker/Podman) with Kubernetes orchestration.
• Hands on experience with IaC/CaC tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm, and GitOps tools like Argo CD.
• Experience supporting cross domain solutions, secure network flows, and MLS/MILS architectures.
• Familiarity with DevSecOps practices, CI/CD integration (GitLab, Jenkins, Bitbucket), and cloud automation pipelines.
• Ability to serve as a cloud technical advisor, mentor engineers, and support enterprise level cloud modernization.
• Experience supporting cloud testing, performance monitoring, incident response, and resilience engineering.
• Strong understanding of cloud security, Zero Trust models, STIG hardening, and RMF/cATO-aligned controls.

Desired Qualifications and Experience:
• Network or Security Operations Center background; familiarity with DoD acquisition and test enterprise.
• Experience with commercial cloud and optical networking solutions.
• Experience with cybersecurity automation, vulnerability scanners, and continuous monitoring frameworks.
• Prior support to CMCC, CBC2, AOC Falconer, DI, JFN, or related DAF C3BM programs.

Desired Skills and Certifications:
• CompTIA Cloud+, Security+ (IAT II), SAFe Agilist certification.
• AWS / Microsoft / Google / IBM / Cisco cloud certifications.
• Experience with multi-layer security, cross-domain solutions, and NSA RaisetheBar standards.
• Experience with Continuous ATO, RMF, Program Protection Plans.
• Experience with Kubernetes, containers, Zero Trust architecture, and modern source control tools (Git, Bitbucket).
• Strong technical writing, documentation, and briefing skills.
• Understanding of hybrid cloud/local architectures at scale.

What will you be doing?

Purpose of the role

Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.

Accountabilities

Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.

From designing the systems that power global real-time communication to writing software that brings deep visibility into our cloud infrastructure, our work has direct impact every single day.
